native.models: Exact GT-03 SHA-bound model copies; no download/substitution
native.input: 640x160 white RGB with synthetic Latin chord-like text only; no scores
native.execution: Serial isolated processes; 60 seconds each; memory 4GiB, CPUs 2, network none; existing default backend enable_mkldnn=False
native.failure_policy: Capture stage markers/logs/exit; no parameter/model/version sweep or score OCR retry

visual.selection: Earliest two non-system-initial printed Bb measures with pitched notes, one-to-one physical registration, all DIRECT or explicit provenance ownership, complete 4/4 stream of undotted quarter notes and quarter rests; no beam/flag/tie/slur/augmentation/tuplet/grace/explicit accidental/moving articulation/fermata or ending/repeat in scope. Record all earlier rejected candidates. Only source-side evidence used. No reselection after render.
visual.chords: Missing source chords remain INCOMPLETE; permitted MUSIC-ONLY layer, never a complete score. Do not derive missing chord text from reference.
visual.geometry: Original page/staff polylines/measure bounds/source x; absolute semantic target y from frozen GT-01 geometry, independently cross-checked with written pitch. Do not modify existing planner.
visual.engraving: Existing locally installed FreeSerif musical Unicode glyphs if present, else block. Glyph E.M. fixed from font outline black-notehead width = 1.25 staff interline; notehead anchor = font outline bbox center, separately measured raster residual. Quarter rest anchor = source rest bbox center; stems geometric tangent, length 3.5 interlines; ledger line width 1.75 interline at logical staff positions. No reference-based font calibration.
visual.context: Non-system-initial excerpt; G clef and target key supplied as explicit external context label, not silently claiming standalone score. Required in-scope structural/attachment symbols not supported block complete excerpt.
visual.composition: New notation canvas only. Untouched original crop shown alongside. No lyric cut/paste into target and no source-pixel erasure.
visual.checks: Per-symbol rendered alpha masks; exact pairwise ink intersections separated into intended notehead/stem/ledger/staff contacts and unexpected collisions. Protected-source dark-ink intersections reported separately from bbox envelopes. Pixel grid anchor residual <=0.5px per axis. No page/measure clipping. No missing/duplicated selected semantic events.
visual.freeze: Hash all prototype PNGs, metrics and limitations before accessing A/G reference comparison; never retune this run.
visual.limits: Technical excerpt only; no production B2 gate completion, no independent musical denominator
